module_summary: UDP checksum generator: an FSM latches the header, sums pseudo-header and payload bytes into a ones-complement accumulator while payload flows into an AXIS FIFO, then pushes header plus length/checksum into a header FIFO for output.

anchors.name: state_reg
anchors.why: Sequences idle, three header-sum states, payload sum and finish-sum.

anchors.name: checksum_reg
anchors.why: Ones-complement checksum accumulator over pseudo-header and payload bytes.

anchors.name: s_udp_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Input header valid; with ready starts a new frame checksum.

anchors.name: m_udp_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Output header valid driven from header FIFO read logic.

anchors.name: s_udp_hdr_ready
anchors.why: Input header ready, asserted in idle when header FIFO not full.

anchors.name: s_udp_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Payload bytes summed into checksum and stored in payload FIFO.

anchors.name: s_udp_payload_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Payload stream valid, gated into FIFO and accumulation.

anchors.name: m_udp_checksum
anchors.why: Computed UDP checksum output read from header FIFO.

anchors.name: frame_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Byte counter giving UDP length and selecting high/low byte alignment.

anchors.name: store_udp_hdr
anchors.why: Loads all input header fields into holding registers on header accept.

anchors.name: shift_payload_in
anchors.why: Opens payload input path into FIFO during payload-sum state.

anchors.name: ip_source_ip_reg
anchors.why: Representative latched header field, summed into pseudo-header checksum.

anchors.name: udp_checksum_mem
anchors.why: Header FIFO storage (representative) holding computed checksum per frame.

anchors.name: header_fifo_wr_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Header FIFO write pointer, advanced when checksum complete.

anchors.name: header_fifo_rd_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Header FIFO read pointer, advanced when output header taken.

anchors.name: m_udp_hdr_ready
anchors.why: Downstream header ready enabling next header FIFO read.

anchors.name: s_udp_payload_axis_tready
anchors.why: Payload ready: FIFO ready gated by payload-sum state.

anchors.name: m_udp_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Output payload bytes from payload FIFO.

anchors.name: header_fifo_full
anchors.why: Header FIFO full; blocks writes and input header ready.

anchors.name: header_fifo_empty
anchors.why: Header FIFO empty; blocks reads and clears output valid.

anchors.name: header_fifo_write
anchors.why: Writes latched header, length and checksum into header FIFO.

anchors.name: header_fifo_read
anchors.why: Loads output header registers from header FIFO.

anchors.name: hdr_valid_reg
anchors.why: Pulses when checksum finished, requesting header FIFO write.

anchors.name: checksum_part
anchors.why: Carry fold of accumulator before final complement.

anchors.name: m_udp_length
anchors.why: Computed UDP length output from header FIFO.

anchors.name: m_ip_length
anchors.why: IP length derived as UDP length plus 20.

anchors.name: busy
anchors.why: Indicates FSM not idle.

groups.name: checksum_fsm
groups.description: FSM sequencing header latch, pseudo-header sums, payload sum and finish.

groups.name: checksum_datapath
groups.description: Header holding registers, byte counter and ones-complement checksum accumulator.

groups.name: payload_fifo
groups.description: AXIS FIFO buffering payload while checksum is computed.

groups.name: header_fifo
groups.description: Multi-field FIFO of completed headers with length and checksum.

groups.name: header_output
groups.description: Output header registers loaded from header FIFO with valid/ready.
